text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Mejiro Bright stopped in front of a showcase.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! That girl with the ocean-colored eyes.
I wonder if she'd be Maki-chan's friend?
choice_data_list: Maki-chan was, if I remember correctly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's about my dear friend, a doll...
I mean, my doll Maki-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
She's a tiny bit shy,
but she's such a hardworking, wonderful girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...I am going to take a look inside the shop.
It seems it will take some time, so
please feel free to head home ahead of me~."

I told her I'd accompany her, and we went inside together.
Lined with antique goods and dolls...
it felt like stepping into a fairy tale.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful... Not only the girl with sea-colored eyes,
but also the girl with snow-colored hair... and ah, that girl too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That girl would look lovely in a dress with scalloped lace, and...
Every single one of them is so adorable, I simply cannot choose~♪
choice_data_list: Each one has its own charm, huh.
Each one has its own charm, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
! Yes, that is correct.
See, if you look closely, their expressions are different too, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The one with curled eyelashes is full of energy and mischief.
The one with the pouting lips looks a bit shy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That is why, as for friends,
someone like Ryan-onesama or Dober
who could pull Maki-chan along would be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I do...?
Pink, huh... It's cute, but on me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Do~ber♪
Are you out shopping too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright...!?
No, um... i-it was just a coincidence, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wanted a new teacup!
I was just walking by and the tableware inside caught my eye!
It's not like I went in just because the shop was cute, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
M-More importantly! Seeing you here is what's rare, Bright!
Coming to a place like this with someone else, no less...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's right~.
They're accompanying Maki-chan in her search for friends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Maki-chan, huh...?
Was she the girl I used to have tea parties with when we were little?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they are my precious friend...
and my precious treasure~.
choice_data_list: You two have always been close, haven't you?
You two have always been close, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Lady Mejiro Dober.
Regarding this membership card—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
!? Y-Yes!
You mean that card I picked up earlier, right?
You found the owner? I'll be right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, I just remembered I have something to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
S-So, that's how it is!
I hope you find a great girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, you seem quite busy.
It seems it will take me a little longer to decide on the child I shall welcome home~..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Does everything seem alright~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes♪
I'll be sure to find the perfect child
for you, Maki-chan~!

Mejiro Bright continued to examine the dolls carefully after that...
...However, closing time arrived before she could make up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The girl with ruby eyes was quite charming too!
But the sea-colored girl had such a big-sister vibe...
Ah, but... the amber-eyed girl was lovely too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Should we invite everyone...? But if we did that,
Maki-chan would be startled out of her wits~...!
choice_data_list: You look happy even though you're troubled.
You look happy despite having worries.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
The time spent deliberating is quite pleasant as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However... look at the time.
Trainer, aren't you feeling tired?
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you having fun.
I'm glad to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My... I'm so delighted~
To hear you say such things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it had a different charm from getting lost in thought all by myself,
and I unexpectedly had a wonderful time~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have sooooo many things
I want to talk about with you today, Maki-chan~♪
choice_data_list: There really are so many ways to enjoy dolls.
There really are so many ways to enjoy dolls, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have sooooo many things
I want to talk about with you today, Maki-chan~♪
choice_data_list: There really are so many ways to enjoy dolls.
There really are so many ways to enjoy dolls, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, about Dober.
She mentioned wanting a teacup,
so I thought I'd ask which one we should gift her~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Also, a dress design that came to mind
while I was searching for new friends.
And lastly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: About the kind words you gave me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just hope we can
finish talking before dawn comes~.

I gently reminded her
to be careful about staying up late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If you're interested,
please do consider welcoming one into your home~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Meeting your "friend" is difficult,
but you understand... the joy in the process, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I will have a fateful encounter~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It would be lovely to hold a tea party together
sometime in the future.

On the way home after that,
Mejiro Bright happily talked to me about dolls!
